prompt: On uber.com, get Uber's price estimate for an UberX ride from {{pickup}} to {{dropoff}}. Do not request a ride. Reply with JSON: {"ride": string, "price_low": number, "price_high": number}, the low and high ends of the estimate in US dollars (the same number twice if the site shows one price).
opt_in: the ride options page asked for a login before showing fares in 2 of 3 rehearsal trials (2026-10-20)
